prompt.zh-TW: 阿哲發現一家銀行的負債比率遠高於課程參考值，比他看過的任何一家商店都高。下列哪一個說法最合理？
prompt.en: Che notices that a bank’s debt ratio is far above the course reference value, higher than any shop he has looked at. Which statement is most reasonable?

text.zh-TW: 銀行吸收的存款就是負債，負債比率天生偏高，應該和其他銀行比較
text.en: Deposits a bank takes in are liabilities, so its debt ratio is naturally high; compare it with other banks

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。銀行是負債比率的典型例外產業，參考值在這裡幫不上忙。
feedback.en: That’s right. Banks are the classic exception for the debt ratio, and the general reference value is no help here.

text.zh-TW: 負債比率遠高於參考值，表示這家銀行的財務狀況已經很危險
text.en: The debt ratio is far above the reference value, so the bank’s finances are already in danger

feedback.zh-TW: 高負債比率值得警覺，這個反應可以理解。不過對銀行來說，靠存款（負債）營運是商業模式本身；判斷它安不安全要用銀行業自己的指標。
feedback.en: Being alert to a high debt ratio is understandable. But for a bank, operating on deposits (liabilities) is the business model itself; whether it is safe has to be judged with banking-specific measures.

text.zh-TW: 存款是存戶自己的錢，不該算進負債，所以這個比率是算錯了
text.en: Deposits are the depositors’ own money and should not count as liabilities, so the ratio is miscalculated

feedback.zh-TW: 存款是銀行欠存戶的錢，確實是負債；數字沒有算錯，只是產業特性讓它天生偏高。
feedback.en: Deposits are money the bank owes its depositors, so they are liabilities; the figure is not wrong, the industry simply makes it high by nature.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_9e1rb64c}}的參考值假設的是一般的買賣或製造業。{{option:o_07yx}}認出了例外產業；{{option:o_0z9b}}跳過產業直接下結論，{{option:o_fcjp}}則否認了存款是負債的事實。
explanation.en: The reference value for the {{term:tm_9e1rb64c}} assumes an ordinary trading or manufacturing business. {{option:o_07yx}} recognises the exception; {{option:o_0z9b}} skips the industry and jumps to a conclusion, and {{option:o_fcjp}} denies that deposits are liabilities.
